title: Registrations Now Open | Scientific Conclave and Interactive Session on Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP) 2026
bodyHtml:
The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) invites registrations for the Scientific Conclave and Interactive Session on Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP) 2026.
Date: 18 March 2026 (Wednesday)
Time: 09:30 AM onwards
Venue: H.T. Parekh Convention Centre, Ahmedabad Management Association (AMA), Ahmedabad, Gujarat
This industry-focused conclave will highlight key scientific and regulatory developments under IP 2026, including:
• Elemental Impurities – Regulatory Overview
• Elemental Impurities – ICP-MS Estimation
• IP Monographs – Development and Revision Framework
• IPRS – Impurities and Reference Standards
• Interactive Discussion and Q&A
Who should attend:
Pharmaceutical manufacturers, Quality Control and Quality Assurance professionals, regulatory affairs personnel, and analytical scientists.
Registration Fee: Rs. 1180/- (including 18% GST)
Seats are limited. Early registration is encouraged. Please register using the QR code provided in the event flyer.
